name: @hl-bos/commercial
description: Shared commercial services for HL-BOS products (TransportationOS, SalonOS): Stripe webhook signature verification and provider-neutral billing events, Twilio signature verification and STOP/START handling, message transports (mock by default; Twilio and Resend refuse to send unless explicitly enabled), the delivery worker with retry and per-company rate limits, and IsolatedDb, which runs SQL exactly as PostgREST does for a signed-in user. Server-side only.
